description: This file defines a specialized database driver class for MSSQL in PHP, specifically for handling Unicode storage by prepending 'N' to string literals, ensuring proper UCS-2 encoding compatibility with MSSQL servers. It extends existing classes to modify query behavior and manage SQL string transformations to facilitate cross-db compatibility.

classes.name: ADODB_mssql_n
classes.description: A subclass of ADODB_mssql that overrides query methods to insert 'N' prefix in SQL literals for Unicode compatibility.

classes.name: ADORecordset_mssql_n
classes.description: A subclass of ADORecordset_mssql with a specific database type for MSSQL with 'N' handling.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to prepend 'N' in SQL strings via _appendN for Unicode compatibility.

methods.name: _appendN
methods.description: Transforms SQL query strings or arrays by identifying string literals and prepending 'N' to ensure correct Unicode storage in MSSQL.
